sources: Kiel Cardio Database v1.0.0, PhysioNet, doi:10.13026/q6r2-zz68
meta.label: Recorded on Earth with real QuSpin OPM sensors. Not an astronaut.
meta.selection: subject 1, trial 3: chosen among subject 1's 25 preprocessed trials as the one with the most prominent QRS (largest ratio of the 99.5th percentile of |B| to the median |B| on any channel), computed on the 2-62 s window so the filter start-up transient in the first second does not drive the choice
meta.sensors: four QuSpin QZFM Gen 1 OPMs in two-axis mode, magnetically shielded chamber, Kiel University (README)
meta.preprocessing: by the dataset authors: scaling by OPM sensitivity, 1 Hz high-pass, 100 Hz low-pass, 50 Hz band-stop (README); SpinDrift only cut a 60 s window
